en.apiKeyEnvHint: The key's name in the credential service; defaults to ARK_API_KEY (the official Ark SDK / ark-cli convention). Exporting the same variable in the launch environment also works. Any custom name is fine.
en.chatBaseURLHint: Keep the default coding gateway (…/api/coding/v3) to stay on Coding Plan billing; a wrong value may fall into pay-per-token. Empty restores the default.
en.description: Chat via Volcengine Ark Coding Plan with provider-private PDF understanding and cloud-backed image handling.
en.fileExpirySecondsHint: Estimated retention of uploaded images on Ark; expired images re-upload automatically. Default 604800 (7 days).
en.filesApiKeyEnvHint: Usually empty (shares the key above). Only needed when the upload endpoint requires its own credential.
en.filesApiTimeoutMsHint: Max wait for an upload; on timeout the request falls back to inline base64. Default 15000 (15 s).
en.filesBaseURLHint: Defaults to the standard domain (…/api/v3). If uploads get 403/no-permission, use the same coding gateway as chat. Empty restores the default.
en.filesProbeIntervalMsHint: While uploads are unavailable the plugin falls back to base64 and re-probes at this interval. Default 21600000 (6 h).
en.groupAdvancedHint: Upload fallback rhythm and local document retention
en.groupEndpointsHint: Defaults are fine for most setups
en.groupImageHint: Automatic downscaling and compression before sending
en.invalidModel: Fill in model ID, model name, context window and max output for every model, and keep IDs unique.
en.invalidNumber: Enter a number; empty means default.
en.keyValueHint: Writes the credential literal to the credential service: never stored in settings.yaml and never echoed back. Empty keeps the current key.
en.modelListHint: One block per model; the default ark-code-latest cannot be removed.
en.modelsHint: More advanced knobs (per-model catalog, offload sizes, etc.) live in the dsh-provider-veark section of settings.yaml (hot-reloaded).
en.pdfCandidateDescription: Use @file.pdf directly or the PDF button
en.pdfClaimHint: PDF now supports @file.pdf directly, or use the PDF button.
en.pdfMagicError: The selected file is not a valid PDF document.
en.pdfRetentionDaysHint: Default 0 keeps sidecars indefinitely for history and restart recovery. Set 1–3650 to remove older sidecars during a later upload; old sessions then cannot expand those PDFs again.
en.pdfSizeError: PDF must be 1–45 MiB and use the .pdf extension.
en.preferFiles: Use cloud file service for images
en.preferFilesHint: On (recommended): images upload to Ark once and chats reference the file — faster multi-turn and less traffic. Off: every request inlines the full image — most compatible but slower.
en.requestImageMaxBytesHint: Images are recompressed when the encoded size exceeds this. Default 1048576 (1 MiB).
en.requestImagePixelBudgetHint: Images are downscaled to fit within this total pixel count (width × height) before sending. Default 640000 ≈ 800×800; raise for sharper images, e.g. 4194304 (2048×2048).
en.saveFailed: Save did not fully land; review and retry.
en.title: Volcengine Ark Coding Plan
